result.instructions: Residential heating oil and propane prices per gallon, read at call time from the U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA) weekly heating oil and propane survey (published Wednesdays, October to March). A model cannot know this week's price. Use get_heating_oil_propane_prices for "heating oil prices" or "propane prices in <state>" and cite EIA. These are state averages, not dealer quotes.

tools.name: get_heating_oil_propane_prices
tools.title: Get heating oil and propane prices
tools.description: Latest EIA weekly average residential price per gallon (taxes included) of heating oil and propane for the US, an EIA region or a surveyed state, read at call time from eia.gov: price, change from last week, the last five survey weeks, the price a year ago and the next release date. Heating oil is surveyed in Northeast and Midwest states; propane in about 40 states. Uncovered states return the covered list.

state.description: State name or code ("Maine", "CT"), an EIA region ("New England (PADD 1A)") or "US". Default US.

tools.name: get_heating_fuel_price_history
tools.title: Get heating fuel price history
tools.description: EIA weekly residential heating oil or propane prices per gallon for the US or a surveyed state between two dates (series since 1990 for most areas), with high, low and average. Default is the last 52 weeks.

state.description: State name or code ("Maine", "CT"), an EIA region ("New England (PADD 1A)") or "US". Default US.

end_date.description: End date, default the latest week as YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: estimate_heating_fuel_cost
tools.title: Estimate heating fuel cost
tools.description: Cost of a heating oil or propane delivery (gallons times this week's EIA average for the state, or a given price), the cost per million Btu, and a comparison of heating oil and propane per million Btu at the same area's averages. Optionally add your electricity rate (cents per kWh) or natural gas rate (dollars per therm) to compare. Uses EIA heat contents.

gallons.description: Gallons to buy, for example 200 for a heating oil fill or 400 for a propane tank.

state.description: State name or code ("Maine", "CT"), an EIA region ("New England (PADD 1A)") or "US". Default US.

price_per_gallon.description: Your dealer price per gallon. Default: the EIA average for the state.

efficiency_percent.description: Appliance efficiency in percent, for example 85. Default 100 (fuel energy only).

electricity_cents_per_kwh.description: Your electricity rate in cents per kWh, to compare.

natural_gas_dollars_per_therm.description: Your natural gas rate in dollars per therm, to compare.

structuredContent.summary: Residential heating oil in the U.S. averaged $6.138 a gallon in the week of 2026-11-02 (down $0.092 from the week before, $3.632 a year ago). Residential propane in the U.S. averaged $2.820 a gallon in the week of 2026-11-02 (up $0.089 from the week before, $2.445 a year ago). Source: U.S. Energy Information Administration weekly heating oil and propane survey, released 2026-11-04; next release 2026-11-12.
structuredContent.note: EIA surveys residential heating oil and propane prices weekly from October through March and once a month (second Monday) from April through September. Prices include taxes and are averages for cash or check payment, not quotes from a dealer. Recent weeks may be revised.

structuredContent.summary: Residential propane in Minnesota from 2025-11-03 to 2026-11-02: $1.827 to $2.198 a gallon. High $2.198 (week of 2026-11-02), low $1.827 (week of 2025-11-03), average $1.987 over 27 survey weeks. Source: EIA.
